$comment: version-keyed, wiped on success. Survives soft-reset because .release/ is
untracked. This committed copy documents the shape; do not edit the live one
skip_review          --skip-review was passed; the coda is skipped.
last_tag             tag the release is scoped against.
reset_target         soft-reset target: last_tag on a first cut, or
is_rerun             the target ## [version] block pre-existed in CHANGELOG.
head_sha             HEAD when the last step finished; resume refuses if
HEAD moved underneath the orchestrator (staleness guard).
confirmed_covered_set  paths the last recut committed; reconcile reports
the delta against it as advisory context.
second_opinion       reviews run so far (release, fixes); each runs once.
coda_pushes          coda pushes Copilot had engaged with; at 1 the round is
spent and a thread it would fix becomes an escalation.
